name: pavitas-plugins
description: Custom plugin suite for Pavitas Productions LLC

plugins.name: audiobook-production
plugins.description: End-to-end audiobook production: script analysis, recording prep, QC, delivery, invoicing. Bundles the audiobook-script-analyzer and audiobook-project-setup skills.

plugins.name: daily-ops
plugins.description: Daily workflow orchestration: briefings, handoffs, email triage, task capture, day reviews

plugins.name: creative-writing
plugins.description: Story Grid fiction toolkit: scene analysis, mentor submissions, prose cleaning, dictation processing

plugins.name: pavitas-content
plugins.description: Weekly Pavitas Productions social content generation (IG/FB post + TikTok/Shorts script) from Notion inputs

plugins.name: spins-yarns-content
plugins.description: @pavi.spins.yarns content + craft docs (Instagram only): weekly drop (2 IG posts from Notion inputs, Canva assets), one-off post drafting, pattern transcription, project logs/tracking

plugins.name: pavitas-core
plugins.description: Core skill architecture: router, constraints (safety-rails, workspace-context, output-quality), orchestrators (morning-review, audiobook-kickoff, story-session, content-pipeline, infra-session), handoff, decision-framework, proof, using-slashy

plugins.name: slashy-ops
plugins.description: Email and calendar operations on Slashy MCP: morning email brief, EOD wrapup, batch draft writing, meeting scheduling, deal/relationship tracking. Requires pavitas-core for using-slashy mechanics.

plugins.name: story-grid-skills
plugins.description: Story Grid beat-writing mentorship coaching: mock grading against the real examiner's bar, Socratic line-editing, drill-worksheet generation, brainstorming/pressure-testing, and knowledge-base sync.

plugins.name: hunt-skills
plugins.description: The scavenger-hunt family: event-style walking hunts for groups (scavenger-hunt-designer), lightweight on-the-go presence-anchoring hunts (pocket-hunt), and intimate solo/partner/group hunts (pleasure-hunt).

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Task management (TASKS.md) and two-tier workplace memory (CLAUDE.md + memory/) with a visual dashboard, adapted from Anthropic's generic productivity plugin for a solo operation: Notion serves as both knowledge base and project tracker, Gmail/Google Calendar handle email and scheduling, gaps are checked against Supermemory before asking twice, and Zo Computer covers persistent activity scanning and recurring automations.

plugins.name: pdf-viewer
plugins.description: View, annotate, and sign PDFs in a live interactive viewer, customized for a solo narration operation: script prep markup (pronunciations, character cues, breath/pause, pickups, typos, author questions), publisher-contract review and signing, and contractor tax forms (W-9). Adapted from Anthropic's pdf-viewer. Local MCP server, no API keys.

plugins.name: xcode-skills
plugins.description: Apple's official Xcode/Swift engineering skills: SwiftUI best practices and performance review, new SwiftUI APIs in the 2027 OS releases (SDK 27), UIKit app modernization, Swift Testing migration, C -fbounds-safety adoption, Xcode security build-setting audits, and on-device UI verification.

plugins.name: miscellaneous
plugins.description: Standalone skills that don't belong to a domain plugin: Pavitas Productions business documents (invoices, contracts, branding), Cora email CLI, MCP wrapper building on Zo, and relational/emotional regulation support.
